description: The website builder for everyday people. PageRush websites are highly performant and SEO-friendly by design. PageRush is a text-based website builder, not an AI website generator. It turns formatted text into live websites and renders it deterministically through supported landing-page and blog elements. PageRush takes care of layout, hosting, performance, and technical details, so you can focus on the content. It lets you create, publish, and manage landing pages and articles directly from ChatGPT. ChatGPT users can publish their most recent page for free, allowing for a full experience right away.
